title: Devin Pricing 2026: Free, Pro, Max, Teams and Enterprise | No Code MBA

facts.fact: Devin's Free plan costs $0 per month and includes a light quota to code with agents.
facts.quote: Free costs $0 and includes a light quota to code with agents

facts.fact: Devin's Pro plan costs $20 per month.
Devin's Max plan costs $200 per month.
Devin's Teams plan costs $80 per month for the team plan plus $40 per month for each full dev seat, for up to 200 users.
facts.quote: Teams is $80 per month for the team plan plus $40 per month for each full dev seat, for up to 200 users.

facts.fact: Devin's Enterprise tier is custom-priced and billed in Agent Compute Units (ACUs).
facts.quote: custom Enterprise pricing billed in Agent Compute Units (ACUs)

facts.fact: In April 2026 Cognition retired the old Core and Team plans, including the $500/month Team entry point.
facts.quote: In April 2026 Cognition retired the old Core and Team plans, including the $500/month Team entry point.

facts.fact: Old Core plan users were moved to Devin's Free plan after the Core plan was retired.
facts.quote: Old Core users moved to Free.

facts.fact: Self-serve Devin plans use included quota plus on-demand usage billed in dollars, while Enterprise stays on ACUs.
facts.quote: Self-serve plans now use included quota plus on-demand usage billed in dollars. Enterprise stays on ACUs.

facts.fact: Per the article, Devin's pricing page says free use of SWE-2 Free in Devin Desktop and the CLI runs through October 16, 2026.
facts.quote: Devin's page also lists free use of SWE-2 Free in Devin Desktop and the CLI through October 16, 2026

facts.fact: On Devin's Pro plan, usage beyond the included allowance is billed at API pricing.
facts.quote: If you go past your allowance, extra usage is consumed at API pricing.

facts.fact: Per the article, Devin's pricing page lists concurrent-session limits of up to 10 on the lower plans and unlimited on the top plans.
facts.quote: up to 10 on the lower plans, unlimited on the top ones

facts.fact: Devin does not publish a specific number for how much higher Max quotas are than Pro quotas.
facts.quote: Devin does not publish a specific number for how much higher, so treat Max as a purchase

facts.fact: Every paid Devin plan includes a usage allowance that refreshes automatically on a daily and weekly basis.
facts.quote: Every paid plan includes a usage allowance that refreshes automatically on a daily and weekly basis.

facts.fact: Devin says most users will not hit their usage limits.
facts.quote: Devin says most users will not hit their limits

facts.fact: Devin's Free plan includes unlimited inline edits and unlimited Tab completions.
facts.quote: unlimited inline edits and unlimited Tab completions

facts.fact: On Devin's Teams plan, each full user gets their own quota and access to Devin Desktop.
facts.quote: Each full user gets their own quota and access to Devin Desktop.

facts.fact: The No Code MBA guide on Devin pricing was last updated October 9, 2026.
